description: Netzgebiet Telekommunikation der EWE NETZ GmbH in Ems-Elbe is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ewe-netz.de. EWE NETZ operates a telecommunications network, which on the one hand forms the basis for our modern information and control technology in order to control and monitor our electricity and natural gas networks. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Network area Telecommunications of EWE NETZ GmbH in Ems-Elbe" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Leittechnik, Telekommunikation, inspireidentifiziert, Steuerkabel. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
